role: Circle-scoped chore and project scalar coordination
known_patches: Neutral prefix, integer id argument/seed normalization and synthetic source users
Resolve declared scope.where session literals as actual session expressions
limitations: All 100 original tools retained; ten declared tools certify scalar records, owner integer, due date and active flags. No full scheduler, approval/points or notification execution claim.
Source create does not materialize all assignees or defaults; completechore inserts a history row without advancing due date or awarding points. It is retained but not certified as full completion.
updatedAt is accepted without optimistic concurrency validation; assignedTo/assignee do not validate every membership/selection constraint.
Most chore guards require any UserCircle membership; circle-scoped row keys/read scopes isolate declared target circle but source private-chore, active-role and admin-only rules are incomplete.
includeArchived/includeSubtasks and general list ordering/filter parameters do not implement their full application meaning; archive/unarchive only changes is_active.
